# `team.update`

Update a team

Session-only, organization owners. The owners team is immutable. Requires If-Match.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/{team}/edit`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team update`
- MCP: `team_update`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
